summary: Validated the new PIN (code secret 4 chiffres) authentication end-to-end on the deployed Expo preview + FastAPI backend. All 8 requested AUTH flows PASS and the SÉCURITÉ requirement is satisfied: no plaintext PIN is ever persisted — only {scheme:'pbkdf2-sha256', iterations:100000, saltHex, verifierHex, version:1} records appear in the state blob (verified via GET /api/state after creating Patron 1234, planteur 4321, Magasinier 5555). AUTH 1 (Créer une coopérative → COOPTEST/Diomandé Mamadou/0700000001/1234) opens the Patron dashboard; mismatched PINs (1234 vs 5678) show 'Les deux codes ne correspondent pas.' and the 'Créer & accéder…' button does nothing (no navigation). AUTH 2 reconnects the Patron with Nom+Tél+1234 → dashboard reopens (topbar-logout visible). AUTH 3: PIN 9999 → red error 'Code secret incorrect.' visible, no navigation. AUTH 4: Créer un compte planteur (Kouassi Yao Test, Sikensi, CI-TEST-01, Cacao chip, 0711111111, PIN 4321) → planteur space opens. AUTH 5: wrong PIN 0000 → 'Code secret incorrect.'; correct PIN 4321 → connexion planteur OK. AUTH 6: Patron → onglet Équipe → +Ajouter → Magasinier + tel 0722222222 + PIN 5555 crée le collab; le warning de mismatch (5555/6666) s'affiche bien. AUTH 7: Se connecter comme Magasinier (Nom+Tél+5555) ouvre l'espace Magasinier (nav-jour visible, aucun nav-coop). AUTH 8: modification de la fiche Magasinier (nom → 'Magasinier Test 2') en laissant les champs PIN vides → l'ancien PIN 5555 permet toujours de se reconnecter. Backend pytest 9/9 sur /app/backend/tests/test_valeo_api.py (GET/PUT /api/state, /health via /, admin login/token/state, wipe HTML). No red screen, no console errors, no deprecated Expo packages introduced.
action_items: None — PIN feature is fully wired and secure. Safe to ship.
critical_code_review_comments: pin.ts uses PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (100k iterations, 16-byte random salt via expo-crypto Crypto.getRandomBytesAsync, 32-byte derived key) and a constant-time equality check — matches the spec and industry practice for local PIN verifiers.

auth.tsx Login: coop login normalizes name (NFKC+lowercase, partial match) and phone (digits only, min 6), and the client only accepts /^\d{4}$/ before calling verifyPin — no client-side leakage of the correct PIN in errors; the generic 'Code secret incorrect.' string is used.

sheets.tsx MemberSheet + CollaborateurSheet correctly treat PIN as OPTIONAL in edit mode (pinTouched=false ⇒ pinOk=true, and the record.pin is only overwritten when a fresh valid PIN is provided) — matches AUTH 8 expected behavior and verified live.

store.ts createLoginCoop/createLoginPlanteur store the pin record verbatim in the staff/members entry, and updateStaff/updateMember do a shallow merge so an edit without pin keeps the previous verifier — confirmed via GET /api/state after the AUTH 8 flow.
Server /api/state is a plain get/put on the whole blob; the backend never sees the plaintext PIN and never generates a verifier — the entire PIN check is client-side, per spec.
seed_data_creation: Created via UI during test: COOPTEST cooperative with Patron 'Diomandé Mamadou' (0700000001 / PIN 1234), planteur 'Kouassi Yao Test' (Sikensi / 0711111111 / PIN 4321), Magasinier 'Magasinier Test 2' (0722222222 / PIN 5555). All persisted through /api/state with PBKDF2 verifiers only. State was reset to empty between runs via POST /api/admin/login + PUT /api/admin/state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE=https://app-deploy-187.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin password admin123. Reset to empty via POST /api/admin/login then PUT /api/admin/state with server.empty_state() shape. Login screen placeholders: coop side = 'Nom & prénoms' / 'Téléphone' (use exact=True — 'Code planteur ou téléphone' also matches 'Téléphone' loosely) / 'Code secret (4 chiffres)' (also used for planteur side — index by .first for coop, .nth(1) for planteur). Créer flows: 'Ex. Société Coopérative COOPAGRI' (nom coop), 'Ex. Diomandé'/'Ex. Mamadou' (responsable), placeholder '••••' for the two PIN fields (index 0/1). Cacao chip on CreatePlanteur/CulturesPicker renders '🍫 Cacao' so use get_by_text('Cacao') WITHOUT exact=True. PBKDF2 100k iterations takes ~600–1200ms on Hermes/web — always wait ≥2500ms after clicking a 'Se connecter' or 'Créer' button before checking navigation. To verify the PIN is stored securely, GET /api/state and confirm each staff/member 'pin' has scheme='pbkdf2-sha256' + saltHex + verifierHex + iterations=100000 + version=1 (and only those keys).
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature validation only. All 10 test scenarios from the request (8 AUTH + REGRESSION + SÉCURITÉ) verified green.
